chooser.title: New product
chooser.description: Start from scratch or from the barcode on the package.
chooser.phoneHint: Point your phone at a QR code and read the barcode with its camera.
chooser.cameraHint: Use this phone or tablet's camera.
chooser.existsDescription: A product already uses this barcode.
chooser.batchHint: Scan one barcode after another and fill in the rest in a table.

pair.title: Scan with your phone
pair.description: No need to sign in on the phone: the QR code is a one-time link.
pair.qrAlt: QR code that opens the barcode scanner on a phone
pair.step1: Open the camera on your phone and point it at the QR code.
pair.step2: Tap the link that appears and allow the camera.
pair.step3: Aim at the barcode: the form opens here, already filled in.
pair.error: Could not create a QR code.

batch.step1: Open the camera on your phone and point it at the QR code.
batch.step2: Tap the link and allow the camera.
batch.step3: Scan one product after another: each one becomes a row here.

camera.title: Read the barcode
camera.description: Hold the barcode inside the frame, a hand's width from the camera.
camera.denied: Camera access was blocked. Allow it in the browser settings, or type the code.
camera.unavailable: No camera available here. Type the code instead.

phone.readyBody: Allow the camera and aim at the product's barcode. The code goes straight to the computer.
phone.sentBody: You can go back to the computer: the new product form is open there.
phone.sendError: Could not send the code. Check the connection and scan again.
phone.invalidBody: QR codes work once and for 10 minutes. Show a new one on the computer and scan it again.

batch.readyBody: Read one barcode after another; each goes straight to the computer. Tap "Done" when you finish.
batch.doneBody: Go back to the computer to fill in the products.
batch.closedBody: The computer finished this session. To scan more, show a new QR code there.
